text:
tess: Tiny UX pass while prepping a compliance demo. Not a blocker but a few things that confuse customers and screen readers.

omar: Drop them here.

tess: 1) Visual ordering: header chips render as [region] [key]. Folks read that as "region includes encryption" which is misleading. Options: move the key chip left of region, or convert it to a labeled token like `Encryption: Customer key (BYOK)` / `Encryption: Redwood key`.

tess: 2) Short/long label pattern: for narrow breakpoints show short label `Customer key (BYOK)` and expose full phrasing in tooltip and aria-label. Keeps mobile tidy and translations cheaper.

nisha: Agreed. Also suggest a tiny key icon before the chip to hint "ownership" vs "location".

a11y-bot: Accessibility note: current SR output is "chip, button" which lacks context. Use aria-label="Encryption: customer-managed key (BYOK). Press for details." and add aria-describedby to a visually-hidden node explaining "Encryption indicates who controls the key; storage region is separate." When details panel opens set role="status" on the hint text so SRs get announced.

omar: 3) Focus style: keyboard outline is faint. Minimum: 2px solid accessible color or system focus token. Also fix tab order so the chip is reached before any secondary tooltip control.

tess: 4) Region fallback copy: we currently show a small "fallback" badge with no context. Customers ask why retention rules differ. Proposal: change to `Region: EU (fallback)` and tooltip: "Data stored in EU fallback region due to capacity; retention defaults may differ. See Data residency docs." Keep tooltip under 140 characters for localization.

nisha: 5) Audit export consistency: CSV lines are terse and all-caps verbs. That makes exports hard to read and brittle for downstream consumers. Suggest explicit header and sentence-case events. Example to export:
```
event_time_utc,event,user_email,details
2024-11-02T14:32:00Z,Key rotated,admin@example.com,Customer key rotated to version v3
```
This preserves timezone clarity and is translation-friendly.

a11y-bot: Also ensure the audit table uses proper roles (role=row, role=cell) and that sortable columns include aria-sort and visible sort indicators.

omar: 6) Backwards compatibility: if we rename `time` to `event_time_utc` in the CSV header, keep a server-side alias for `time` during a deprecation window and note the change in release notes. Avoid breaking scripts.

tess: 7) Docs sync: after UI text changes, update screenshots and examples in Data residency + KMS docs. Small task for docs to avoid mismatch.

nisha: I'll mock two chip placements in Figma (left-of-region and grouped-but-separated) and add a short CSS toggle so we can QA quickly.

ops-bot: Created ticket PKG-862: "Encryption chip ordering + a11y + audit export header" (labels: ux,a11y,docs).

tess: Thanks all. @nisha when sketches land can @a11y-bot run a quick NVDA/VO pass?

a11y-bot: Will run checks once PR is up. Remember to test with long translations and narrow widths.

omar: Good catch. Small but high impact for demos and enterprise customers.

tess: End.
